Theorem initial_from_weakly_initial `(W : WeaklyInitialFamily C) (P : Limit (DiscreteCat_Functor (wif_obj W))) (Pe : Limit (DiscreteCat_Functor (fun _ : (iprod (wif_obj W) P ~> iprod (wif_obj W) P) => iprod (wif_obj W) P))) (E : HasEqualizers C) : @Initial C. — the in-tree route to the item's CONCLUSION, but from the Freyd product-and-equalize-all-endomorphisms hypotheses (weakly initial family + two products + equalizers), i.e. Riehl's Lemma 4.7.5, not from a coseparating set and intersections.

statement_record.book: If C is locally small, complete, has a small coseparating set Φ, and every collection of subobjects of an object has an intersection, then C has an initial object; the initial object is the intersection of ALL subobjects of the product ∏_{k∈Φ} k, and uniqueness of arrows out of it follows because an equalizer of two competing arrows would be a strictly smaller subobject.

statement_record.book: Freyd's Representability Theorem: a continuous functor F : C → Set on a complete, locally small C is representable provided it satisfies the solution set condition — a SET Φ of objects such that for every c and every x ∈ Fc there are s ∈ Φ, y ∈ Fs and f : s → c with (Ff)(y) = x. Proof: the solution set is jointly weakly initial in * ↓ F ≅ ∫F, which is complete by Lemma 4.7.2, so Lemma 4.7.5 gives an initial object, i.e. a universal element, i.e. a representation.
statement_record.intree: Theorem GAFT ... (comp : @Complete C) (cont : @PreservesImageLimit C D U) (sols : forall d : D, SolutionSet U d) : { F : D ⟶ C & F ⊣ U } (Adjunction/GAFT.v:241).
statement_record.strength_comparison: intree-weaker: the hypotheses match (the in-tree solution set is the book's condition, and PreservesImageLimit is the honest cone-level reading of continuity — stronger than the apex-only class, hence a leaner hypothesis), and every intermediate step of the book's proof is in-tree (Comma_Complete = Lemma 4.7.2, wif_of_sols + initial_from_weakly_initial = Lemma 4.7.5, producing an Initial (=(d) ↓ U) = UniversalArrow), but the conclusion delivered is a left adjoint, not `Representable F`. Definition Comma_Complete (HU : PreservesImageLimit) (HC : @Complete C) : @Complete (=(d) ↓ U) := fun J K => comma_limit HC HU K. — the completeness corollary consumed by GAFT.

statement_record.book: Lemma 4.7.2 (the exercise asks for a direct proof of it): the forgetful functor Π : s ↓ U → A strictly creates limits of any diagram whose limit exists in A and is preserved by U.
statement_record.intree: comma_limit : Limit K, with apex ((ttt, vertex_obj[Ldiag]); phi) where Ldiag := HC J Gdiag and phi := limit_med (image_is_alimit HU Ldiag) base_cone (Construction/Comma/Limit.v:131,151,159,238); packaged as Comma_Complete (line 245).
statement_record.strength_comparison: intree-weaker in hypothesis form and in what is asserted about the lift.
